name: Art Legendary Domain
body:
The domain of art is one of creativity and expression or the love of experiencing the beauty and art of the world around you. As a cleric of the art domain, you are likely to be an actor, artist, musician or art dealer. You immerse yourself in the world of the arts and try to bring its joys to others around you.

Divine Skill: Knowledge (local)

Emotional Experience (Su)

You can cast spells through art to induce an emotional reaction from those around you. When casting a spell with the emotion descriptor you may choose to either apply the Silent Spell or Still Spell feat without increasing the level of the spell or its casting time. If the spell is cast with Silent Spell, you must display a piece of art you have that has some form of emotional connection to you as part of casting the spell. If the spell is cast with Still Spell, you must sing a song or perform a monologue you have an emotional connection to. You may instead expend 1 point of faith and increase the casting time of the spell to one round to apply both Silent and Still spell to the spell. To do so you must display a piece of art and perform a monologue or song, all of which you must have an emotional connection to. This effectively makes the spell completely hidden except for the extravagant emotional display you are making.

Inspiring Display (Su)

At 4th level you gain the inspire doubt and inspire hope bardic performances (see the emotionist bard archetype). You use your legendary cleric level as your effective emotionist level for these abilities. For the purposes of these performances, you gain a number of bardic performance rounds equal to half your cleric level plus your Charisma modifier. If you take levels in bard with the emotionist archetype. The rounds from this ability do not stack with the emotionist, however, you may add half your cleric level to the rounds available to all of the emotionist’s bardic performances and your levels stack for the purposes of determining your emotionist performances. Unlike the normal bardic performances, the visual component, if so chosen, may be showing a piece of work you think is particularly inspiring of the emotion you are trying to convey.

Emotional Transcendence (Su)

At 8th level, whenever you are casting a spell with the emotion descriptor with the emotional experience ability being used, you may expend 1 point of faith to have the spell ignore any resistance or immunity to the spell. This lowers any save bonus vs. the spells (via emotion or mind-affecting resistance) by 2 (minimum of 0). If the target is immune to emotion or mind-affecting spells, they are instead treated as having a +4 bonus to their saving throw against the spell.

Domain Spells: 1st–play instrument, 2nd–minor image, 3rd–major image, 4th-majestic image, 5th–joyful rapture, 6th–irresistible dance, 7th–waves of ecstasy, 8th–scintillating pattern, 9th-resplendent mansion

Doctrine of Composition

Art worthy of your work takes time, money, and dedication to the craft. You revel in its process and the works you create reflect your passion and willingness to express your devotion.

Transcending Artistic Limitations (Su)

When using any item crafting feat to create magic items, you may fulfill the spell requirements of an item by expending an additional 1,000 gp per level of the spell required. Alignment restrictions to the creation may be satisfied by expending 500 gp and class ability requirements may be satisfied by expending 500 gp per class level required to gain that ability. You must still have the requisite item creation feat and any costly material components required by the spell.

A Piece of Yourself (Su)

You have already inserted a piece of yourself in any piece of art you have created, but now you can resonate with that piece of yourself.

Starting at 16th level, as a standard action you may resonate with a magic item you have created by expending 1 point of faith. When resonated with you either double the bonuses granted by the item for 1 minute or you grant an extra charge of the item usable within 1 minute. This extra charge may be a charge for a wand or staff or a daily use of a power for any other item. If the charge is not used within 1 minute, it is lost.

The charge may not be used for charged items that grant wishes or miracles like a luck blade or ring of three wishes. If the magic item has no bonuses and no limited use this ability may raise the DC of the item by 1 but otherwise is not effective. For example, this ability would have no effect on a ring of freedom of movement.

Doctrine of Experiences

Art is meant to be enjoyed and experienced. The feelings you get from experiencing art are meant to be reveled in, good or bad.

Joyful Experience of Emotion (Su)

When under the effects of a non-harmless spell(s) with the emotion descriptor, you may expend 1 point of faith as a free action to ignore the effects of any or all of those spells for a number of rounds equal to your class level. The spell is still active upon you though its duration continues to run while its effects are suppressed.

Additionally you may instead expend 2 points of faith when suppressing the spell effects to also gain the effects of lesser heroism for the duration as well.

Aura of Emotional Enhancement (Su)

At 16th level you gain the ability to create an aura of emotional enhancement. By expending 1 point of faith as a move action you may create a 30 foot aura. Any creature within the aura is subject to the enhance emotions spell (found in this book), Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your legendary cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) negates.

You are also affected by the aura but you may not roll a Will save to negate the effect. This aura lasts for a number of rounds equal to your class level and is a mind-affecting emotion effect.
